name: Fried sticky-rice cakes
summary: Sticky-rice cakes fried crisp and cut small. The rectangle is plain, and the round one holds minced pork, wood-ear, and glass noodles.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names bánh nếp chiên among the cheap snacks in Buon Ma Thuot.
howToEat: Eat them with salty-sweet soy sauce or chili sauce.
where: Phùng Chí Kiên, where a row of stalls sells only this cake.
seoTitle: Banh nep chien in Buon Ma Thuot — fried sticky-rice cakes
seoDescription: Fried sticky-rice cakes on Phung Chi Kien, plain or filled with pork, wood-ear, and glass noodles.
